mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_goods_favorite (user_id, goods_id, create_time, update_time, deleted, version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted = 0, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_goods_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId}
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.user_id, g.category_id, g.title, g.description, g.price, g.original_price, g.`condition`, g.cover_image, g.images, g.status, g.reject_reason, g.view_count, g.favorite_count, g.stock, g.create_time, IFNULL(u.nickname, u.username) AS username, u.avatar AS userAvatar, u.real_verified AS sellerRealVerified, c.category_name AS categoryName, 1 AS isFavorited FROM t_goods_favorite f INNER JOIN t_goods g ON f.goods_id = g.id AND g.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_user u ON g.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_goods_category c ON g.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.deleted = 0 AND (g.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND g.status = #{status} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_goods_favorite f INNER JOIN t_goods g ON f.goods_id = g.id AND g.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.deleted = 0 AND (g.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND g.status = #{status}
